adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, the migration loops over each line `h` from the `embeddable_hosts` site setting and executes raw SQL with string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. Because `h` is not escaped/quoted via the DB adapter, any host line containing a single quote (or other SQL-special characters) can break the SQL and abort the migration (and also presents SQL injection risk from stored data).
